label: Who is Erick?
question: Who is Erick?
answer:
You're talking to an AI hooked up to an MCP version of me — public notes, projects, the stuff I'd actually tell a stranger.

I'm Erick Osterloh. Computer Science at Colorado College (2024–2028, 3.8 GPA), Fall 2026 in Copenhagen. I interned at Google on agentic analytics over conversion pipelines, and at PayNearMe on RAG and evals. I build local inference (`infer` on a DGX Spark), long-running agent harnesses, and that personal MCP. I play hoops. I also founded the CC Golf Club; I'm an 11.7 handicap.

label: My work
question: My work
answer:
Google SWE intern, Summer 2026 — agents, databases, C++, SQL. Debugging dashboard cut conversion-upload latency ~95%. Agentic insights over ~2.1M customers / ~3.5B conversions a day. Customer-issue agent cut investigation time ~75%.

PayNearMe, Summer 2025 — RAG on LlamaIndex (+67% retrieval), evals with RAGAS and Arize Phoenix.

Things I actually ship:
- [lab](https://github.com/eosterloh/lab) — RSI harness. 8M-parameter Llama-style model: eval, research, train on TinyStories. 3.5-day budget. Research stays in a sandbox; promotion is gated on an eval the agent does not control.
- [infer](https://github.com/eosterloh/infer) — local inference engine. Drop in config.json and weights, get tokens out, greedy-decode parity with HuggingFace logits. Agents use it to swap architectures in training runs.
- Personal MCP — public and private context for any MCP agent. Private files need a token.
- [Pixel Watch](https://github.com/eosterloh/WearOSJava) — swing-detection CNN. 10M+ accelerometer, gyro, and heart-rate points from my own swing.

Languages: Python, C++, Java, C, JavaScript, Go. Also agents, harnesses, RAG, TensorFlow, PyTorch, inference optimization, databases.
